w:r.w:t: Clickkaar is a photography and videography equipment rental business based in Pune, India. We rent out cameras, lenses, lighting, tripods, audio gear, and related accessories to photographers, filmmakers, and content creators.

We are looking to hire a skilled web developer to build a brand-new, modern, professional website that allows customers to browse our catalogue, book equipment online, and pay — all without needing to call or visit in person.
Turn our website into a fully functional online rental platform that generates bookings 24x7 without manual intervention.
This is not a simple brochure website. We need a complete online rental business platform. Below are the exact features required.
A clean, browsable catalogue of all rental equipment organised by category — Cameras, Lenses, Lighting, Audio, Tripods & Support, Accessories.
Each product must have: name, high-quality photo, short description, daily / weekly rental price, and availability status.
Customers must be able to filter by: Category, Brand (Canon, Nikon, Sony, Fujifilm etc.), Price range, Availability (Available Now toggle).
Search bar to find gear by keyword.
Product detail page for each item with full specs, multiple images, and a Book Now button.
Each product must have a date picker so the customer can select their rental start date and end date.
The system must automatically block dates that are already booked — no double bookings allowed.
Rental duration must auto-calculate the total price (e.g. 3 days x ₹500/day = ₹1,500).
A booking summary / cart where customers can add multiple items to one booking.
Booking confirmation page and confirmation email sent automatically to the customer.
Admin must receive a notification (email or WhatsApp) for every new booking.
Integrate a payment gateway — Razorpay or PayU (India-friendly, supports UPI, cards, net banking, wallets).
Customer must be able to pay full amount or a security deposit at time of booking — we will decide the policy, developer must make both options configurable.
Payment receipts sent automatically to the customer's email.
All transactions logged in the admin panel with status: Paid / Pending / Refunded.
Refund initiation must be possible from the admin panel.
Customers can register and log in using email/password OR Google/Facebook OAuth.
Customer dashboard showing: Active bookings, Past bookings, Upcoming returns, Saved wishlist of gear.
OTP-based mobile number verification at registration (for security and to reduce fake bookings).
Option to save delivery address in profile for faster checkout.
Separate admin login (not visible to customers).
Inventory management: Add / Edit / Delete products, Upload multiple images per product, Set daily & weekly pricing, Mark item as unavailable (e.g. under maintenance).
Booking management: View all bookings (upcoming, active, completed, cancelled), Manually mark an item as returned, Add internal notes to a booking.
Dashboard with key metrics: Total bookings this month, Revenue this month, Items currently out on rent, Overdue returns.
Ability to manually create a booking from admin (for walk-in or phone customers).
A blog section to publish photography tips, gear guides, and news — this helps with Google ranking.
Each blog post must have: Title, cover image, author name, publish date, category tags, and SEO meta fields (title, description, keywords).
Admin must be able to write and publish blog posts without touching code (rich text editor like TinyMCE or similar).
Blog listing page and individual post page, both mobile-friendly.
Hero banner, USP highlights, featured gear, how it works, testimonials, CTA
Full product grid with filters and search
Individual gear page with images, specs, calendar, Book Now
Review selected items, dates, and total price
Bookings history, active rentals, profile, wishlist
Story, team, why choose us, store address + map
Contact form, phone, WhatsApp link, location map
All published posts with filters by category/tag
Individual article page with SEO meta
Common questions about rental process, damage policy, delivery
Rental agreement, damage liability, cancellation policy
Data usage policy (required for payment gateway approval)
Friendly error page with navigation back to site
Design must be modern, clean, and professional. Target audience: photographers, filmmakers, content creators — they have a good eye for design, so the site must look premium.
Mobile-first design — majority of our customers browse on phones. Site must look and work perfectly on all screen sizes.
Fast loading — images must be optimised. Pages should load in under 3 seconds.
Consistent use of our brand colours and logo across all pages — we will provide our logo and brand colours.
High-quality product photography is critical — the product image layout must showcase gear beautifully with zoom-on-hover or lightbox on click.
Clear and prominent CTAs (Call to Action) — 'Book Now', 'Check Availability', 'WhatsApp Us' buttons must be easy to find.
WhatsApp chat button fixed on every page (bottom-right corner) for instant customer support.
Look at sites like MPB.com, BorrowLenses.com, or Primes & Zooms (primesandzooms.com) for layout inspiration. We want something in that league of professionalism.
Website must be fully SEO-optimised — proper meta tags, fast page speed, sitemap.xml, robots.txt, structured data (Schema.org) for products.
SSL certificate (HTTPS) — mandatory for payment gateway.
Google Analytics and Google Search Console integration.
Contact and booking forms must have spam protection (reCAPTCHA or similar).
All customer data stored securely — passwords hashed, payment data never stored on our server (handled by payment gateway).
Admin panel must be accessible from desktop and tablet.
5.2 Preferred Tech Stack (Open to Developer Suggestion)
If the developer has a preferred stack that delivers the same result more efficiently, we are open to discussing it — please justify your choice in your proposal.
6. What We Expect You to Deliver
Fully functional, tested website deployed on our domain.
Mobile responsive on all major browsers (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Samsung Internet).
Admin panel with all inventory and booking management features.
Source code handed over to us on project completion (GitHub repository).
Basic documentation: how to add products, manage bookings, publish blog posts.
3 months of free bug-fix support after launch (not new features — only fixing bugs in what was built).
Training call (1 hour) to walk our team through using the admin panel.
No WordPress + WooCommerce unless you can strongly justify why it is the right fit — we prefer a custom-built solution for performance and control.
No page builders like Wix, Squarespace, or Webflow — we need a real codebase we own.
No shared hosting — the site must be on a reliable VPS or cloud server.
No stock photography used on the site — we will supply all product and brand images.
Do not start designing without sharing a wireframe or mockup first for our approval.
